T1.implementation_approach: Design a responsive UI using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks like React or Angular. Implement components for listing, searching, and filtering problems.
T1.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and accessibility.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion using a backend framework like Node.js or Django.
T2.notes: Ensure proper authentication and authorization mechanisms.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema with tables for problems, tags, and metadata. Use SQL or NoSQL databases.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a UI for code submission using frameworks like React or Vue.js. Include input fields, file upload options, and submission buttons.
T4.notes: Validate user input and provide real-time feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a backend service to execute submitted code in a sandboxed environment and evaluate results against test cases.
T5.notes: Ensure security by sandboxing code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a containerized environment using Docker to isolate code execution and provide necessary dependencies.
T6.notes: Include support for multiple programming languages.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a UI for user profiles using React or Angular. Include sections for personal details, progress tracking, and achievements.
T7.notes: Ensure responsive design for mobile and desktop.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs for managing user profiles, including updating personal details and tracking progress.
T8.notes: Implement secure authentication and data encryption.

T9.implementation_approach: Create a UI for the leaderboard using React or Vue.js. Display rankings, scores, and filters for sorting.
T9.notes: Optimize for real-time updates and scalability.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to fetch leaderboard data, calculate rankings, and update scores.
T10.notes: Ensure efficient ranking algorithms for large datasets.

T11.implementation_approach: Design a UI for hints and explanations using React or Angular. Include collapsible sections and search functionality.
T11.notes: Focus on intuitive navigation and readability.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and explanations, including creation, retrieval, and updates.
T12.notes: Ensure proper categorization and tagging for easy retrieval.

T13.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests for the problem repository functionality using testing frameworks.
T13.notes: Test edge cases and ensure API reliability.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop test cases to validate code submission and evaluation workflows, including sandboxing and test case execution.
T14.notes: Simulate real-world scenarios for comprehensive testing.

T15.implementation_approach: Test user profile creation, updates, and progress tracking using automated and manual testing methods.

T16.implementation_approach: Write test cases to validate leaderboard functionality, including ranking algorithms and real-time updates.
T16.notes: Test for scalability and performance under high load.

T17.implementation_approach: Develop test cases to ensure hints and explanations are correctly displayed and retrieved.
T17.notes: Focus on UI/UX testing for readability and navigation.

T18.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using cloud services like AWS or Azure. Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.
T18.notes: Ensure scalability, security, and high availability.

from app.database import db

class Problem(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'problems'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    difficulty = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp(), onupdate=db.func.current_timestamp())

    def __init__(self, title, description, difficulty):
        self.title = title
        self.description = description
        self.difficulty = difficulty

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'title': self.title,
            'description': self.description,
            'difficulty': self.difficulty,
            'created_at': self.created_at,
            'updated_at': self.updated_at
        }

code_repository.readme_content:
# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems.

## Features

- Problem Repository: A comprehensive collection of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles and Progress Tracking: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.
- Leaderboard: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.
- Hints and Explanations: Provides hints and detailed explanations for problems to help users learn and improve.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
